title: What a beautiful piece of art
text: What a beautiful piece of art. What a beautiful piece of art!  This shell looks like the real thing.  It's bigger than I expected, but I am thrilled with it's look and size.  I think it's great that it's made in the U.S.A.

product_metadata.title: House Parts Large Clam Shell
description: This Large Clam Shell is a striking piece of beach decor, perfect for tabletops, buffets or dressers. Infuse your space with the loveliness of the ocean with this fun clam shell that looks complete even when empty. This seashell decor would look elegant filled with pearl-like decorative balls. You might even add sand to the bottom and put your own seashell collection on display. Hand crafted in gypsum Realistic, textured with a fossil finish Extremely durable Decorative use only For indoor use only No assembly required
